leads.name: Real-Time Joint Audio-Video Generation by Parallel Adapter Composition (arXiv 2610.10343)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: v2 names the authors (Jingyu Li, Xiaoxiao Xiang, Yiwen Guo) but there is no lab of note and no venue yet (ICLR 2027 submission), and its 26 fps, 30-second streaming audio-video at 480x832 is represented by shengshu--vidu-s1.

leads.name: PhysStream (arXiv 2609.17521)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: interactive only in the control sense (0.74 fps, 2.54 fps accelerated, on one GPU per the paper) and limited to tabletop rigid bodies; physics-responsive interactive generation is covered by odyssey--odyssey-3 and decart--oasis-3.
